description: A First Information Report Based Road Traffic Accident Dataset from the Rajshahi–Pabna Highway, Bangladesh is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Md. Nayem Hossain Md. Nayem Hossain, Md. Rifat Hossain Md. Rifat Hossain. This repository contains a structured FIR-derived road traffic accident dataset collected from the Rajshahi–Pabna Highway corridor (N6) in Bangladesh. The dataset includes 457 officially recorded accident cases from 2020 to 2024, extracted from highway police First Information Reports (FIRs). Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
